body.name: Connected equality-factor product
body.construction: \(\mathcal H=\operatorname{cc}(\mathcal E)\) and \(K^{\mathrm{split}}=\prod_{H\in\mathcal H}K_H\), where \(K_H=\{x_H\in\mathbb R^H:H_Hx_H\le h_H\}\), \(H_H=\begin{bmatrix}A_H\\-A_H\\-I_H\end{bmatrix}\), and \(h_H=\begin{bmatrix}b_H\\-b_H\\0\end{bmatrix}\); \(A_H,b_H\) use every raw row whose support lies in \(H\).
